scope: Broaden the open-source DXF parser and browser-consumer screen, reconcile mutable source claims with released artifacts, and refine the ACIS/AcDs sample-route admission boundary without increasing the fast validation loop.

method.kind: Public source, package, and issue review plus prior local plan/source-audit reconciliation
method.limitations: GitHub and npm statements are source/documentation evidence, not runtime results. LibreDWG issue #1411 was not reproduced and its pinned historical report does not establish the current branch behavior. The prior @dxfjs/parser ObjectsParser audit is cited as existing plan evidence and was not repeated by cloning source in this pass.

sources.observed: The public main-branch README lists 3DFACE and 3DSOLID and major sections; the package manifest is version 0.3.2, while npm shows the latest published artifact was published three years ago. The published checklist still leaves OBJECTS parsing incomplete. The earlier source audit recorded that ObjectsParser skips records and the public parse result omits OBJECTS. Exact source-to-tarball equivalence was not established, and no runtime or payload-level 3DSOLID audit was performed in this pass.
The README identifies this as a dxf-viewer fork embedding gdsestimating/dxf-parser and describes a 2D renderer. This is a correlated renderer route, not an independent parser.
The README describes the browser/Node parser as based on LibreDWG, so it is not an independent DWG implementation.

The open issue reports an ezdxf-authored AC1032 DXF with a 5,489-byte SAB REGION, a LibreDWG dxf2dwg conversion, and a subsequent dwg2dxf output with empty SAB and no AcDs data. The report identifies LibreDWG commit 8a1ae764. The report was not reproduced, and no claim is made about every current build or writer path.
sources.qualification: Negative-route candidate only after exact build pinning; not a positive DWG pair or independent semantic witness.

readiness: Pin current source and published artifact separately; do not transfer mutable branch claims to an old registry package.
Inspect exact parser handler and exposed fields before scoring 3DSOLID; entity recognition is not SAT/SAB preservation or geometry semantics.
Treat dxf-renderer as gdsestimating/dxf-parser lineage and libredwg-web as LibreDWG lineage.
Use the LibreDWG #1411 route only as a pinned negative-loss diagnostic unless independent evidence establishes AcDs/SAB owner linkage and geometry.
Preserve local-generated-only fixture policy and keep peer setup outside implementation fast slices.
